summary.text: Holly Seibold is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 12, which covers part of Fairfax County.
Holly Seibold has been a member since 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Holly Seibold was born in New London, Connecticut.
Holly Seibold studied at American University (B.A., Communications, Law, Economics, and Government, 2000) and George Washington University (M.Ed.).
The profile lists Erik Hooper Seibold as Holly Seibold's spouse.

The House profile lists Holly Seibold's committee assignments as General Laws (Vice Chair), Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Public Safety, and Holly Seibold chairs the Technology and Innovation subcommittee of Communications, Technology and Innovation.
